title: When the Contact Turns Anew
premise: Ulyana Underhill, a hostage negotiator haunted by the one call she couldn't save, receives a calendar invite from her dead handler, Marcus Vane, scheduling a meeting for tomorrow at 9:00 a.m. — the exact time and place of an 'accidental' gas explosion that will kill hundreds. Following Vane's posthumous breadcrumbs, she discovers he faked his death to infiltrate a private security syndicate that stages disasters to sell protection contracts. With her estranged former partner Dev Osei and a young syndicate defector named Priya who becomes the family none of them had, Ulyana must choose between obeying the agency rules that once failed her and breaking every protocol to stop the attack. In the end she talks the trigger-man down using the words Vane left her, exposes the syndicate at devastating personal cost, and finally forgives herself for the failure that defined her.
about_author: Jude Okafor is a former crisis-line counselor turned novelist who writes thrillers about people forced to make impossible choices in minutes. They live in Manchester with two rescue dogs and an unhealthy knowledge of emergency response protocols.

chapters.title: The Invitation
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. Five years after a negotiation ended in nine deaths, Ulyana trains new negotiators by the book — until a meeting invitation arrives from Marcus Vane, her handler who died last spring. The invite is timestamped for tomorrow, 9:00 a.m., at Meridian Plaza. When she reports it, her agency flags HER as compromised. Emotional beat: dread sharpening into defiance as she realizes no one will listen.

chapters.title: Dead Man's Protocol
chapters.summary: Alternating Ulyana and Dev POV. Ulyana recruits Dev Osei, the partner she pushed away after the failure, and together they decode Vane's hidden messages: he faked his death inside Halcyon Risk Group, a firm that engineers disasters to sell security contracts. A terrified young analyst, Priya, defects with proof of tomorrow's staged gas explosion. Emotional beat: reluctant trust rekindling into found family.

chapters.title: Nine O'Clock
chapters.summary: Priya's POV opens; shifts to Ulyana at the climax. The trio infiltrates Meridian Plaza's control systems before dawn, but Halcyon anticipates them — Dev is captured, Priya is exposed, and the trigger-man, a coerced building engineer, arms the blast with Ulyana talking to him through a stolen intercom, using Vane's recorded final words. Emotional beat: terror transmuted into the negotiation of her life.

chapters.title: What Survives the Fire
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. The engineer stands down; the plaza evacuates as the bomb gutters out, and Ulyana broadcasts Halcyon's ledger to every newsroom before the syndicate can silence her. Dev survives; Priya testifies; the agency offers Ulyana her old badge back and she declines, choosing to build something unregulated and humane instead. Emotional beat: grief finally set down — survival was never the price, it was the point.
